maria: Morning async — quick standup.

maria: What I did: landed eviction backoff for spot nodes, updated autoscaler heuristics, iterated on the eu-west quota request form.

maria: Blockers: still seeing a transient backlog on the prefetch queue in eu-west-2 after node reclaim; investigating whether it's kube-proxy or daemonset scheduling.

maria: Today: collect kube-proxy logs, open a short canary of the autoscaler change to 10% traffic, and file a support case with cloud provider if backlog persists.

sam: Thanks — noted. I bumped the spot request cap in our account (console ticket #8421) and added a temporary safety rule to avoid < 1s preemption storms.

kai: PR #4362 is up for the autoscaler heuristic; left one comment about the weight math. Planning to cut a canary image by EOD.

li: If you need logs, run:
```
kubectl -n rw-inference logs -l app=prefetch --since=2h | grep error | tail -n 200
```
I can attach if you want.

maria: grabbing the logs now, will paste a sample in a minute.

deploy-bot: [alert] Canary rollout started for image: rw-inference/autoscaler:canary-2026-03-18 — 10% traffic.

sam: FYI, I scheduled a quota increase call with cloud rep for 4pm UTC. If either of you wants a 10min slot to show the backlog, ping me.

kai: I'll be on that call after the PR review. Also posting a short note in the ops runbook about temporary cap settings.

li: No blockers from my side. If the kubectl log shows the kube-proxy niffling, I can drop a fix for the iptables rule tomorrow.

maria: sample log snippet:
```
prefetch-7b9c2 2026-03-18T07:24:11Z ERROR kv-lookup timeout=120ms key=ctx:user:cache
prefetch-7b9c2 2026-03-18T07:24:12Z WARN  backlog=23 pending=5
```

maria: conclusion: looks like spikes coincide with node reclaim events. I'll correlate node events with backlog timestamps and post findings here.

sam: Great. If the correlation holds, let's try delaying reclaim for 30s in the spot drain hook as a quick mitigation.

maria: noted — scheduling that change to canary as well.

kai: pinging @li for a fast CR once you have the delay code.

li: will do, aiming for a tiny patch.

maria: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
